title: Glacier Steps A-Z
hook: Mountain time is more than one walking beat.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: polished 3D glacier-and-trail storybook, ice blue with warm hiking accents, safe friendly scene, strong silhouettes

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child comparing timescales beside a glacier without stepping onto dangerous ice
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: restate fast-slow-old-now as the learning framework
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: measured 4/4 with fast pickups against long sustained ice phrases
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written timescale contrast; glacier and landform facts are distinct from animal motion and human gear
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: fast/slow/old/now cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe timing gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. small echo responses after targets, with acoustic walking pulse
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: small echo responses after targets, with acoustic walking pulse
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Use glacier time as the song's signature: animal steps happen in seconds, snow changes by season, valleys and kettle lakes preserve old ice stories, and glacier flow happens far more slowly than a walking beat.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child compares fast, slow, seasonal and geological change along one glacier-adjacent trail.
imageMotifs: fresh hoofprint beside old moraine-like rock
ice moving too slowly to see
semanticArc: return to present trail and seasonal snow
